arabic text: KARBAL MEIN LAHOO SE, DEEN KI SHAMMA JALI HAI
english translation text: THE CANDLE OF RELIGION WAS LIT WITH THE BLOOD IN KARBALA

arabic text: IS DEEN KI BAQA HAI, TO HUSSAIN IBNE ALI HAI
english translation text: YOU ARE THE ONE WHO CAUSED THE RELIGION TO SURVIVE – YOU ARE HUSSAIN IBNE ALI

arabic text: JALTA HUWA SEHRA HAI MAGAR TISHNA LABI MEIN
english translation text: IN THE SCORCHING HEAT OF THE DESSERT, AND WITH HIS LIPS PARCHED

arabic text: TALWAAR JIGAR GOSHAAE – ZAHRA PE CHALI HAI
english translation text: A SWORD WAS STRUCK ON THE HEART OF ZEHRA

arabic text: KHOON KAANO MEIN HAI LAALI HAI RUKHSAARE SAKINA
english translation text: THERE WAS BLOOD IN HER EARS, HER EARINGS AND HER CHEEKS

arabic text: IS HAAL MEIN SHABBIR KI– NAAZO SE PALI HAI
english translation text: THIS IS THE STATE OF THE ONE WHO WAS BROUGHT UP BY SHABBIR WITH SO MUCH LOVE

arabic text: HAL CHAL SI HAI MAIDAAN MEIN KON AYAA HAI DEKHO
english translation text: THERE IS CHAOS IN THE DESERT, LOOK WHO IS HERE

arabic text: ANDAAZ WOHI HAI – YA HAQEEQAT MEIN ALI HAI
english translation text: HE HAS THE SAME STYLE, IN REALITY ALI IS HERE

arabic text: ABBAS RIDA CHEENI GAYI TERI BEHEN SE
english translation text: ABBAS YOUR SISTER’S COVERING WAS SNATCHED FROM HER

arabic text: AA DEKH KE RASSIYON MEIN – BANDHI SHAAM CHALI HAI
english translation text: COME LOOK SHE IS TIED IN ROPES AS SHE WALKS TO SHAAM

arabic text: EK LAASH KE TUKRO MEIN HAI KUCH SEHRA KI TAARE
english translation text: ADMIST THE PIRCES OF A BODY THERE WERE THE STARS (WISHES) OF A WEDDING

arabic text: PEHCHAAN KE MAAN FARWA NE– SAR KHAAK MALI HAI
english translation text: WHEN MOTHER FARWA SAW THE PIECES, SHE BURRIED HER HEAD IN THE GROUND

arabic text: DEEWARO PE JEE BHARKE INHE LIKHNE DO BAARI
english translation text: LET THEM WRITE ON THE WALLS TO THEIR HEARTS CONTENT

arabic text: KAAFIR HAI AGAR KOI – TO GHUSTAAKE ALI HAI
english translation text: IF ANYONE IS A KAFIR, THEN THEY ARE THOSE WHO WRONGED ALI
